name: P&C Specialty Quality (de-rated E&S compounders)
thesis: Elite excess-and-surplus (E&S) underwriters whose pricing cycle is substantially — not fully — priced after a contained property-cat de-rate, while the structural core keeps compounding book value at high returns on equity. The pair buys underwriting quality at a lower multiple than it usually commands and layers a float/net-investment-income carry that keeps working as long as book yields stay elevated. KNSL is the de-rated growth leg (a bounce off the trough, not the trough itself); WRB is the diversified carry-and-compounding anchor. It resolves as underwriting margins hold, book value compounds, and the multiple normalizes — and it is falsified if E&S submission growth (not just rate) rolls over, signalling the growth was cyclical rather than structural.
